node.title: XR rank-two received-pair interactions are alternating or zero
node.statement: Actual selected-block agreement forces each rank-two coefficient column to annihilate the interaction vector of its polynomial row-space basis with the received directions b,q. In the three-anchor slope-linear basis, the 2x2 interaction matrix is ((0,eta),(-eta,0)); in the four-anchor branch all four interactions vanish. These conditions exactly recover the selected trade-row parity equations, but not the other h-1 block checks. Compatible support-extension counting, first-core ownership, and aggregate payment remain open.
